name: screenvision
description: Screen Vision — captures screenshots and returns them to the AI. PNG default for accurate text reading. Supports grim (Wayland), region zoom, sharpening, and connector-name targeting.
author: sapphire

settings.label: Monitor Number
settings.help: Which monitor to capture. 1 = primary monitor, 2 = second monitor, etc. Set to 0 to capture all monitors combined.

settings.label: Capture Interval (seconds)
settings.help: How often to take a screenshot in the background (1–15 seconds).

settings.label: Auto-start monitoring on launch
settings.help: Automatically begin capturing screenshots when Sapphire starts.

settings.label: JPEG Quality (1–95)
settings.help: JPEG quality for background monitoring captures. On-demand capture_screen uses PNG by default (lossless).

settings.label: On-demand Capture Format
settings.help: Format used by capture_screen. PNG is lossless and reads text far more accurately. JPEG is smaller.

settings.label: Auto-sharpen captures
settings.help: Apply unsharp-mask sharpening to every on-demand capture. Improves small text legibility.

settings.label: Inject status hint into system prompt
settings.help: When monitoring is active, remind the AI that screen capture is available.
